narration: Ishaan steps back from the torch. The crocodile shrinks.
caption: इशान टॉर्च से पीछे हटता है। मगरमच्छ छोटा हो जाता है।
image_brief: Ishaan a step back from the stool, his crocodile shadow on the wall shrunk to the size of his palm, light spreading past him.

narration: He leans in close. It swells across the plaster.
caption: वह पास झुकता है। परछाई दीवार पर फैल जाती है।
image_brief: Ishaan leaning in until his hands almost touch the torch, an enormous crocodile shadow spread over the wall and the closed door.

narration: Closer to the light means bigger. That rule he has.
caption: रोशनी के पास जाओ तो परछाई बड़ी होती है। यह बात उसे पता है।
image_brief: Ishaan's two hands very near the torch bulb, the huge shadow behind them, the wooden edge of the stool in the light.

narration: But bigger on the wall, not the ceiling. Wrong place.
caption: पर परछाई दीवार पर बड़ी होती है, छत पर नहीं। जगह ग़लत है।
image_brief: The bedroom wall filled with a giant crocodile shadow while the ceiling above it stays dark and plain.

narration: Ishaan tries the edge of the cot. It creaks under him.
caption: इशान खाट के किनारे पर चढ़ता है। खाट उसके नीचे चरमराती है।
image_brief: Ishaan balancing on the narrow wooden edge of his cot with his arms out, torch light throwing his whole body up the wall.

narration: His sister shushes him. Why does the shadow refuse to climb?
caption: बहन उसे चुप रहने को कहती है। परछाई ऊपर क्यों नहीं चढ़ती?
image_brief: The little sister with one finger against her lips in her cot, Ishaan frozen above her on the cot edge, torch glow between them.

narration: The torch points sideways. So the shadows go sideways.
caption: टॉर्च बगल की तरफ़ देख रही है। इसलिए परछाइयाँ बगल में जाती हैं।
image_brief: The torch on the stool aimed straight at the wall, a level beam of light crossing the dark room at chest height.

narration: Ishaan turns his hands upside down. Same wall, same size.
caption: इशान अपने हाथ उलटे कर लेता है। वही दीवार, वही नाप।
image_brief: Ishaan's hands held upside down in the beam, the crocodile shadow appearing on the wall belly-up with its jaw on top.

narration: He pushes a pillow into the light. A lump appears.
caption: वह रोशनी में तकिया अड़ाता है। दीवार पर एक ढेला बन जाता है।
image_brief: Ishaan holding a flat pillow in front of the torch, a shapeless dark lump printed on the bedroom wall.

narration: Not a crocodile. A rolled blanket makes a whale.
caption: यह मगरमच्छ नहीं है। लपेटा हुआ कंबल व्हेल बना देता है।
image_brief: Ishaan holding a tightly rolled blanket in the beam, a fat whale-shaped shadow on the wall, his sister watching from her cot.

narration: Bend three fingers into a snout, like Ishaan. Ready?
caption: इशान की तरह तीन उँगलियाँ मोड़कर लंबी नाक बनाओ। तैयार?
image_brief: A child's hand with three fingers curled into a snout shape, held in warm torch light against a dark bedroom background.

narration: Ishaan builds the best jaws yet. Knuckles make the teeth.
caption: इशान अब तक का सबसे अच्छा जबड़ा बनाता है। पोरों से दाँत बनते हैं।
image_brief: Ishaan's interlocked hands forming a toothed crocodile jaw, the torch bright behind his knuckles, a sharp shadow on the wall.

narration: Two hand-spans long. The ceiling would need ten.
caption: परछाई दो बालिश्त लंबी है। छत के लिए दस चाहिए।
image_brief: Ishaan measuring the wall shadow with his spread hand, thumb to little finger, the crocodile shape beside his fingers.

narration: He shoves his hands right against the torch. Light leaks around them.
caption: वह अपने हाथ टॉर्च से सटा देता है। रोशनी उनके किनारों से छनती है।
image_brief: Ishaan's hands pressed so close to the torch that light glows red through the edges of his fingers and thumbs.

narration: The wall crocodile is huge now. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
caption: दीवार का मगरमच्छ अब बहुत बड़ा है। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
image_brief: A wall-filling crocodile shadow with its jaws wide open, Ishaan's small dark shape below it, the torch blazing behind.
